args.title: Fix screen reader announcement delay and auto-dismiss timer for error toasts
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Change the aria-live attribute in ToastProvider from 'polite' to 'assertive' to prevent delay in screen reader announcements. Also, modify the auto-dismiss timer so error toasts do not auto-dismiss but remain until explicitly dismissed, as required.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ToastProvider component currently sets the aria-live attribute to 'polite', which causes screen readers to delay announcing toast messages. Additionally, all toast messages use a fixed auto-dismiss timer of 5000ms. As a result, error toasts vanish automatically instead of remaining visible until dismissed, which does not meet the issue's requirements.
